title: Induction of granule and Purkinje cells from primary cultured mouse cerebellar progenitors
protocol: Sterilize the surgery tools, operation area and dissection microscopes.
Euthanize one Sox2CreERT2/ Gt(ROSA)26SortdTomatoto pregnant mouse by using methods approved by the animal welfare committee.
Take out all the embryos from the pregnant mouse under binocular microscope and put them in cold L15 medium.
Dissect the cerebellar anlage under binocular microscope using fine microsurgical tweezers.
Collect dissected tissues into a 6 cm petri dish filled with cold L15 medium on ice.
Aspirate all collected tissues in 2 mL of L15 medium and transfer to a 15 mL tube.
Add 2 mL of 0.05% Trypsin-EDTA to the 15 mL tube for digestion.
Incubate at room temperature (RT; 15°C–25°C) for 10 minutes, gently shaking every 2 minutes.
Triturate tissues using a p1000 pipet by slowly and gently pipetting up and down about 20 times until few tissue clumps are visible.
Check tissue digestion samples regularly to avoid overdigestion.
Put the 15 mL sample on ice for 5 min if there are tissue clumps left after pipetting.
Collect supernatant into a new 15 mL tube and proceed to step 8.
Add new digestion buffer (2 mL L15 medium + 2 mL 0.05% Trypsin-EDTA) to the original tube with precipitate and keep on ice for another 5 min, then repeat tissue digestion steps.
Add 2 mL digestive termination buffer (NBC+FBS+DNAse I) to the 15 mL tube after adequate digestion.
Dissociate cells by gently pipetting up and down in the tube containing digestive termination buffer.
Centrifuge at 150 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove supernatant and resuspend cell pellets in 2-4 mL NBC medium (without phenol red).
Count cell number: Mix 25 μL cell resuspension with 25 μL fresh NBC, then add 50 μL Trypan blue.
Put 20 μL of the mixture in a cell counting chamber and count at least 5 squares.
Calculate total cell number using mean cell numbers in squares × 400 = cells/μl, then cells/μl × volume of suspension = total cell number.
Seed cells at a density of 2-4 x 10^5 per well in pre-coated 24-well plates.
Add tamoxifen to each well directly at a final concentration of 5–500 pg/mL.
Incubate the cells in a 5% CO2 37°C incubator for 2–3 h.
Check Rosa-Tomato signals under fluorescence microscope.
Begin time-lapse video recording when sparse Tomato signals could be detected.
Set up parameters for cell proliferation stages.
Acquire time-lapse images every 30 minutes for Cy3 and bright field over 72 hours using a 10× objective (512*512 resolution).
Prepare four wells for each time-lapse video recording experiment.
Stop and immediately restart acquisition every 24 hours to avoid crashing, or more frequently if needed.
Check temperature, CO2 concentration, and water regularly during the experiment.
Change to differentiation medium for Pax6+ granule cells after three days.
Start the program again with the same parameters for cell differentiation.
Take out the plate at day 7.
Change to differentiation medium for Calbindin+ Purkinje cells.
Start the program again with the same parameters.
Fix cells directly using 4% PFA and incubate for 10 min at room temperature.
Wash cells 3 × 10 min in 1 × PBS, using 1 × PBT (1 × PBS containing 0.1% Triton-100) initially to increase permeability.
Block with 10% normal donkey or goat serum in 1 × PBS for 1 h at room temperature.
Incubate fixed cells overnight at 4°C or for 3–4 h at room temperature with primary antibodies diluted in 1 × PBS containing 1% normal donkey or goat serum.

Incubate fixed cells with appropriate secondary antibodies conjugated with Alexa Fluor 488 at a dilution of 1:500 in 1 × PBS containing 1% normal donkey or goat serum for Calbindin, and with Alexa Fluor 647 at a dilution of 1:500 for Pax6.
Wash cells three times for 10 minutes each in 1 × PBS.
Incubate cells with DAPI (1:2000) for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Wash cells three times for 10 minutes each in 1 × PBS.
Mount cells with Vectashield.
Scan the stitched files day by day to follow the proliferation and differentiation of each single clone.
Note the positions of selected clones.
Use Image J to open the stitched files.
According to written positions, crop the target areas one by one to a consistent size large enough to include the entire cell at the end of differentiation.
Check the size of the target clones that are taken photos on the last day of live imaging before cropping.
Crop and save all the target regions for each file.
Use Image J to open these cropped images.
Reconstruct videos for each clone.
